SCI-FRUIT ORDINARY-MAP FIRST METHOD — SCOPE APPROVAL
AND NEXT PAPER-DEFINITION DIRECTION

I approve D001–D005 as scope and bounded paper-only preparation directions,
subject to the clarifications below.

The revised MAP-first direction is accepted. Do not produce another standalone
scope-review cycle or reopen the frozen generic FRUIT core.

This approval does not select a numerical method, feedback projector, selector,
coefficient value, coverage_cut value, iteration count, executable, observation,
or experiment. Author dispatch and execution remain separately authorized.

1. PRESERVE THE REVISED SEPARATION

The first newly specified method is for one observation, separately identified
array bundles, compact-source-pointing use, and unfiltered normalized ordinary
SCI-MAP feedback.

Keep the historical JINC control unchanged. JINC specialization remains later
work with its own method identity.

Retain original-measured-parent reruns and complete-map replacement as the
candidate recurrence direction to define. Do not infer cumulative processing
of the preceding residual.

The matched piecewise-constant feedback projector remains an illustrative
candidate, not an approved operator.

2. CLOSE BOTH SIDES OF THE PTC INTERFACE

Extend U02/U03 into one explicit two-sided boundary task:

    exact pre-removal producer product
      -> model subtraction
      -> FRUIT residual
      -> authorized PTC application
      -> residual PTC output
      -> FRUIT rejoined sample product
      -> authorized ordinary MAP input.

For each crossing, identify:

- exact producer and consumer product roles;
- quantity, unit, reference/gauge, support and occurrence identity;
- existing authority that suffices, or the precise missing permission;
- any bounded boundary or controlled successor required;
- affected response, uncertainty, validity and provenance.

Do not relabel a residual as unchanged CAL output or a rejoined descendant as
unchanged PTC output.

Bind the signal population and generation used for every analysis/gridding
coefficient and QC result. Residual-derived, post-rejoin-recomputed, and
explicitly retained coefficients are not aliases.

If the route cannot be closed within the selected scope, return the specific
unavailable-route disposition before expanding it.

3. RETURN CONCRETE METHOD RULES

Use the existing twenty-one-class record. For each unresolved method choice,
return an exact proposed rule or one precise blocking question.

Prioritize:

- candidate/accepted/applied model construction and transformations;
- feedback projection and its normalized-MAP round trip;
- selector inputs and exact companion meanings;
- residual-operation and bypass graph;
- state fixed, reevaluated or relearned at each stage;
- removal, rejoin and final MAP support;
- flags, coefficients and QC after rejoin;
- missing/non-finite behavior and failure scope.

Do not import historical gates, fallback behavior or numerical values as
defaults. Keep frozen MAP normalization separate from the separately proposed
feedback projection.

4. RESOLVE BOOTSTRAP AND FINITE-EXTENT SEMANTICS

Propose explicitly:

- the first unseeded iteration and its no-predecessor behavior;
- the first product eligible to become a feedback-model parent;
- whether the extent includes the bootstrap iteration;
- absolute zero-based indexing;
- per-array versus larger-request completion/failure scope;
- the successful terminal-selection rule.

After successful completion of the declared extent, select its final required
completed iteration. A failed required run remains failed; an earlier completed
product is not silently substituted as successful completion.

Preserve earlier immutable products and their exact states without claiming
convergence or continuation sufficiency.

5. PRESERVE HISTORICAL COMPARABILITY

Return a concise historical-to-proposed rule table:

    historical behavior
    proposed ordinary-MAP rule
    unchanged / restricted / changed / unresolved
    reason and owner
    affected identity and claims.

Do not modify the historical control to resemble the candidate.

Keep U08's distinction between mapmaker effects and feedback effects. A later
MAP-versus-JINC difference is not, by itself, evidence of FRUIT benefit.
No experiment design or execution is authorized by this response.

6. RECONCILE SOURCE PERMISSIONS AND WORDING

The three inputs/program documents are proposed author references in the
reference control and author inventory but have proposed_author_reference=false
in SOURCE_IDENTITIES.json.

Make those records agree while preserving their process-only authority.

Use “unfiltered normalized ordinary MAP” rather than ambiguous “raw” wording,
and “separately identified array bundles” rather than language implying
statistical independence.

Keep the exact frozen MAP v0.1/r0.7.1 binding unless a separately approved
successor is explicitly adopted. Do not silently import decisions from a
candidate MAP revision.

7. NEXT DELIVERABLE AND GATES

Return a compact method-definition and boundary-closure proposal containing
the concrete rules, U01–U08 dispositions, historical comparison, remaining
owner questions, and updated source bindings.

Do not generate another generic FRUIT contract or PDF set at this stage.
Do not repeat the current list of unknowns without proposing their disposition.

The manager recovery materials remain outside independent scientific
authorship. Any later sanitized author packet and dispatch require their own
exact approval.

No numerical route, implementation conformity, response/covariance fidelity,
uncertainty coverage, source-recovery benefit, pointing accuracy, qualification,
readiness or production authorization follows.
